title: ECCE Key Figures
description: Authoritative list of public-facing numbers shown on the ECCE website. Every figure must carry a source, an owner, and a last-updated date. Build fails if any required field is missing or invalid.

version.description: Semantic version of the figures dataset.

lastUpdated.description: Date the file was last updated, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).

owner.description: Name or role of the person responsible for this dataset (e.g. 'Genia Chicherova, IARC').

id.description: Stable kebab/snake identifier, used in code. Never change after publish.

unit.description: Optional unit suffix (e.g. 'samples', 'years', '+'). Use null for no unit.

prefix.description: Optional prefix (e.g. '€', '$'). Usually null for ECCE.

display.description: exact = display as-is; approx = render with '~' or '+'; target = render as 'target: X' or '/X'.

asOf.description: ISO 8601 date this value was correct as of.

url.description: Optional URL to the canonical source.

owner.description: Person or role who owns the value (e.g. 'Genia Chicherova, IARC project manager').

showOn.description: Routes where this figure may render (e.g. ['/', '/about', '/research/wp1-epidemiology']). Omit for global.

isPublic.description: If false, kept in dataset but excluded from the build.
